categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land settlement and title registration processes, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
